newsitem.title: RUSSIA: FORECAST-Russian MOF sees 3 pct GDP rise in 1998.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Russian MOF sees 3 pct GDP rise in 1998.

text.p: Russia's gross domestic product will grow by three percent in 1998 (rpt 1998) and will rise by a further five to six percent a year until 2005, the finance ministry said on Friday.
It did not provide a forecast for 1997. Some ministers have said that growth, previously hoped for this year, may not start next year either.
It forecast GDP per capita in 2005 will be just over the current Portuguese level which it put at $8,000 compared with Russia's current $3,300, a ministry forecast said.
